text_block_list.text:
"Mid-February, on a tranquil afternoon.
As I dozed off in the warm sunlight—"

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Happy Valentine's, Master.
Mihono Bourbon gave me a Valentine's Day gift!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
...Detecting "surprise" from Master's expression.
Why are you "surprised"?

It was a bit surprising that the ever-so-serious
Mihono Bourbon was actually mindful of Valentine's Day.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
My mother and I gave them to my father every year.
Valentine's Day is a regular family tradition.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Well then, excuse me.

Since they took the trouble to prepare it, I wanted to give my impressions.
Hastily unwrapping the package—
Out came a set of neatly, individually wrapped chocolates.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: There were so many varieties in the chocolate aisle that I had trouble deciding, but—

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
I selected this by cross-referencing broad data,
including Master's status, preferences, and today's humidity.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
I prepared high-cacao chocolate with a low GI value.
72% cacao content, with "modest" sweetness.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: It is said to lower blood pressure, improve skin health, and enhance cognitive function—

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Plus, it contains caffeine, so it's great for afternoons when you need a little wake-up boost.

Popping a piece into my mouth, a subtle sweetness spread across my tongue.
Somehow, I felt like I had regained some energy.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
No, um...
"You are welcome," Master.
That afternoon, work went extremely well!

"Inside were several
heart-shaped chocolates."

"With a single bite, a delicate bitterness and sweetness
filled my entire mouth."
"However, it tasted somewhat different from store-bought chocolate, with a slightly grainy texture—"
choice_data_list: Wait, did you make this by hand?

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Yes. It's handmade.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: I intended to purchase ready-made items, but according to reference materials, handmade goods result in a higher level of happiness.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Therefore, insisting on maximum homemade authenticity—
I made this chocolate starting from raw cacao beans.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Initially, I was planning to start
from planting the seeds, but—

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
"However, since they told me it would take four years
until the harvest, I had to give up on it."
choice_data_list: Still, it must have been tough...

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. I was confident
in my stamina, but...

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: The conching process, which required stirring by hand continuously for 72 hours, was quite a bit of work.

Looking closely, Mihono Bourbon's face
somehow looked haggard.

I found myself feeling even more grateful
for the chocolate in my hand.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: ...I see.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
If that is so...
Then I am, um... "happy."
choice_data_list: Would you like to eat together?

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
No, I will not eat it.
That chocolate is meant for Master.
(Kyuuu~...)

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Contractions of the stomach due to hunger confirmed.
Come to think of it, I haven't eaten anything in 72 hours.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
B-But, this was meant for
Master to eat, so—
After that, I somehow managed to persuade Mihono Bourbon, who was being unusually stubborn, and the two of us ate it together.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
...!
Status: "Delicious"...!
